why: Tests step for judgment slice E30 of the Effect-check sweep (strictEffectProvide), in next/. Counted 775 hits in the row's 18 folders on origin/main at f7169af, matching the plan: 765 in exam paths, 10 in product files, 0 in PR 1366's files. Fixed none. Class 1, 757 hits in 129 test files (*.test.ts, *.test-support.ts, *Test.ts suites): each law builds a fresh layer from its own test state (a store, a broken driver, a tracer) and provides it to one test's Effect, so each test is its own entry point; it.layer would share one layer across tests and break their isolation, and Layer.build plus provideContext only hides the same thing from the checker. Class 2, 8 hits in 8 exam scripts and one fixture, each an Effect.provide(NodeServices.layer) handed straight to NodeRuntime.runMain: a real entry point, which the checker cannot see (its rule doc says to disable it there, and no disable is allowed). The 10 product hits are left for the build: 4 in library files (client/Headless.ts:33, node/build/bundle.ts:92, node/dev/watch.ts:166, node/repositories/OpenRepository.ts:151) and 6 in the app's entry files (build.ts:15, dev.ts:110 and 181, hands.ts:109, settings-generate.ts:29, src/entry/browser.tsx:26), the last 6 being the same entry-point class as class 2.
